blocks.text: The MUELLER Sports Medicine Adjustable Lumbar Back Brace with Removable Pad provides firm support to help relieve lower back pain without restricting movement, as well as working to help correct posture during wear. Ideal for back pain, back strains, arthritic conditions, and more, it offers targeted compression to reduce pain and discomfort. Made with breathable mesh material, it ensures comfort, dryness, and prevents odor. Available in sizes Small (22"-30"), Regular (28"-50"), and Plus (50"-70"). Trusted for over 60 years, Mueller Sports Medicine is dedicated to helping you heal, reduce pain, and elevate your performance.

items: 52% POLYESTER, 19% NATURAL RUBBER, 10% NYLON, 5% STEEL, 5% PVC, 3% NEOPRENE, 3% PE, 2% P, 1% EVA FOAM

items.label: TARGETED COMPRESSION
items.value: 4 steel springs deliver firm, targeted, and supportive compression to help alleviate pain and discomfort. Perfect for those lifting heavy objects or needing extra back support throughout the day

items.label: COMFORTABLE & REMOVABLE PAD
items.value: Support and comfortability combined into a versatile back brace with a removable lumbar pad. Ideal for adults dealing with back pain, sciatica, scoliosis, back strains, arthritic conditions,

items.label: EASY TO USE
items.value: The adjustable closure straps allow for easy wraparound and tightening to your comfort level while ensuring our back brace stays in place during most types of activity

items.label: BREATHABILITY
items.value: Breathable mesh material provides comfort for all day wear, with the fabric treated to prevent odor for comfort and high performance. Please measure around the widest part of your waist for the correct size: Small - fits 22"-30", Regular - fits 28"-50", Plus - 50"-70"

items.label: TRUSTED BRAND
items.value: Mueller Sports Medicine has been a trusted leader in sports medicine for over 60 years and is committed to helping you heal, reduce pain, and elevate your performance
